calls.statement:
SELECT 
    sale_date,
    SUM(net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code = 'WB'
    AND sale_date >= '2025-12-15'
    AND sale_date <= '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY sale_date
ORDER BY sale_date

SELECT 
    MIN(sale_date) AS earliest_date,
    MAX(sale_date) AS latest_date,
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows
FROM fact_sales_line

SELECT 
    channel_code,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    MIN(sale_date) AS min_date,
    MAX(sale_date) AS max_date
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2025-12-10'
    AND sale_date <= '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY channel_code
ORDER BY channel_code

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    sale_date,
    channel_id,
    channel_code,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    SUM(net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2025-12-15'
    AND sale_date <= '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY sale_date, channel_id, channel_code
ORDER BY sale_date, channel_id

SELECT 
    sale_date,
    SUM(net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2025-12-15'
    AND sale_date <= '2025-12-23'
    AND channel_id IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY sale_date
ORDER BY sale_date

SELECT 
    d.calendar_date,
    d.day_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) AS net_sales
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f 
    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date 
    AND f.channel_id IN (2, 3)
WHERE d.calendar_date >= '2025-12-15'
    AND d.calendar_date <= '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY d.calendar_date, d.day_name
ORDER BY d.calendar_date
